en.longDescription:
Self-hosted Forgejo with an isolated Forgejo Actions runner backed by Docker-in-Docker.

After deploy, create a runner registration token in Forgejo (Site Administration → Actions → Runners) and set SERVICE_PASSWORD_FORGEJO_RUNNER. The runner auto-registers on first start.

de.longDescription:
Selbst gehostetes Forgejo mit einem isolierten Forgejo-Actions-Runner, der auf Docker-in-Docker basiert.

Erstelle nach dem Deploy ein Runner-Registrierungstoken in Forgejo (Site Administration → Actions → Runners) und setze SERVICE_PASSWORD_FORGEJO_RUNNER. Der Runner registriert sich beim ersten Start automatisch.

fr.longDescription:
Forgejo auto-hébergé avec un runner Forgejo Actions isolé basé sur Docker-in-Docker.

Après le déploiement, créez un jeton d'enregistrement de runner dans Forgejo (Site Administration → Actions → Runners) et définissez SERVICE_PASSWORD_FORGEJO_RUNNER. Le runner s'enregistre automatiquement au premier démarrage.

pt.longDescription:
Forgejo auto-hospedado com um runner Forgejo Actions isolado baseado em Docker-in-Docker.

Após o deploy, crie um token de registro de runner no Forgejo (Site Administration → Actions → Runners) e defina SERVICE_PASSWORD_FORGEJO_RUNNER. O runner se registra automaticamente no primeiro início.
